title: Research: independently audit the complete T740 phase map
body:
## Summary

Independent audit of PR3297 at `bab1899ce1c6fd43d073ac7c3a8e7c3e69008c0e`, restricted to T740 owner 0 / port 0.

```text
canonical raw JSON
  -> separate source projection
  -> 1,174 uncancelled signed paths
  -> all 72 published matrix terms
  -> 20 recovered coordinates, 21 nonzero monomial divisors
```

No predecessor checker is imported. The phase-map theorem and inverse retain Sagar Thakrar's credit. This is corroboration through a different intermediate representation, not a new theorem, supplier or kappa. Full attribution, proof, exact inputs and Open next questions are in `research/t740-phase-map-path-audit/`.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3297 supplies two sparse matrix replays. After: a separate uncancelled-path reconstruction agrees on the complete matrix and checks the inverse with integer Laurent identities.
- CPython 3.12.15 registered normal/optimized replay and ten behavioral groups pass. Controls include five source-semantic faults, a direct Gaussian-integer oracle, divisor faults, source corruption and capacity exhaustion.
- All 21 committed package/input byte comparisons pass. The exact committed export passes read-only, without Git in PATH, on optimized CPython 3.13.5. Runtime pins use canonical ancestry only; the exact predecessor expected-answer JSON is committed with its original hash and blob, not an unavailable foreign-head requirement.
- Ruff and whitespace checks pass. Hosted checks remain a separate exact-head gate.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/t740-phase-map-path-audit
```

Scientific base is canonical `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6, refreshed unchanged before submission. Overlap refresh covered 349 open PRs and 2,148 Discussion records with complete pagination at 21:21 UTC. It does not cover arbitrary diffs or unpublished work. Other-context normalization and arbitrary-address reciprocal-chart repair are separate scopes and not dependencies. [Predecessor investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19004159).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated-package.

No selected, frozen or shared production file changes. The eight-data-stream completed-call interpretation is inherited. Native execution, helper-bank realization, source/consumer routing, stock, precision/tape, complete cost and all-size/outer admission remain unverified. No other owner/port result or independent human/proof-kernel review is claimed. Assistance and review limits are disclosed in TASK.json.
